target.title: fix(ui): localize mobile pairing in Hindi and Russian
target.body:
Related: #94672

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running the Control UI in Hindi or Russian would see English copy in the mobile-pairing flow and six adjacent chat labels because those generated locale entries were recorded as fallbacks.

## Why This Change Was Made

The missing Hindi and Russian strings are now localized, their generated metadata reports complete coverage, and focused regression tests prevent recorded fallbacks or untranslated mobile-pairing copy from shipping again. This is an AI-assisted maintainer follow-up to #94672.

## User Impact

Hindi and Russian users now see localized setup-code, QR, pending-review, commentary, session, and expired-pairing messages. All 20 shipped Control UI locales report 1,438 of 1,438 translated keys with zero recorded fallbacks.

## Evidence

- `node --import tsx scripts/control-ui-i18n.ts check` — passed; 20/20 locales clean, zero fallbacks
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/control-ui-i18n.test.ts ui/src/i18n/test/translate.test.ts` — passed; 2 shards, 19 tests
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.test.ui.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/test-ui.tsbuildinfo` — passed
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local ...` — clean; no accepted/actionable findings
- `git diff --check` — passed
